definitions.explanation: A general term for laws, regulations, and government orders. Encompasses statutes ({法律|ほうりつ}), cabinet orders ({政令|せいれい}), ministerial ordinances ({省令|しょうれい}), and local ordinances ({条例|じょうれい}).

examples.japanese: {法令|ほうれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遵守|じゅんしゅ}する→遵守する：20157_junshusuru⟧。
examples.english: To comply with laws and regulations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{法令|ほうれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new ordinance will go into effect starting next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧{法令|ほうれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すべて⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めて→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check all related laws and regulations before proceeding with the procedure.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, umbrella term covering all types of legal rules issued by government authorities. More inclusive than ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧ (law enacted by the Diet), which refers specifically to statutes. {法令|ほうれい} includes statutes, orders, and regulations at all levels of government.

Commonly seen in official documents, business compliance contexts, and news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法令|ほうれい}⟦{遵守|じゅんしゅ}→遵守：06107_junshu⟧: legal compliance
- {法令|ほうれい}⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧: violation of a law/regulation
- ⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧{法令|ほうれい}: related laws and regulations
- {法令|ほうれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to amend a law
- {法令|ほうれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧: based on law
